seat_owner_valid.name: seat_owner_valid
seat_owner_valid.value: "seat"."table_id" IS NOT NULL OR "seat"."row_label" IS NOT NULL

sector_plan_rect_valid.name: sector_plan_rect_valid
sector_plan_rect_valid.value:
("sector"."x" IS NULL AND "sector"."y" IS NULL AND "sector"."w" IS NULL AND "sector"."h" IS NULL)
      OR ("sector"."x" IS NOT NULL AND "sector"."y" IS NOT NULL AND "sector"."w" > 0 AND "sector"."h" > 0
          AND "sector"."x" >= 0 AND "sector"."y" >= 0)

sector_points_valid.name: sector_points_valid
sector_points_valid.value:
"sector"."points" IS NULL
      OR (jsonb_typeof("sector"."points") = 'array'
          AND jsonb_array_length("sector"."points") BETWEEN 3 AND 64
          AND "sector"."x" IS NOT NULL)

tier_valid_window.name: tier_valid_window
tier_valid_window.value: "tier"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "tier"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "tier"."starts_at" < "tier"."ends_at"

user_role_organizer_coherence.name: user_role_organizer_coherence
user_role_organizer_coherence.value:
("user"."role" = 'SUPERADMIN' AND "user"."organizer_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("user"."role" = 'ORGANIZADOR' AND "user"."organizer_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR "user"."role" = 'STAFF_PUERTA'

ticket_owner_matches_status.name: ticket_owner_matches_status
ticket_owner_matches_status.value:
(
      ("ticket"."status" = 'DISPONIBLE' AND "ticket"."order_item_id" IS NULL AND "ticket"."courtesy_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("ticket"."status" = 'RESERVADO' AND "ticket"."order_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket"."courtesy_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("ticket"."status" IN ('VALIDO','UTILIZADO') AND ("ticket"."order_item_id" IS NULL) <> ("ticket"."courtesy_id" IS NULL))
      OR ("ticket"."status" = 'ANULADO' AND NOT ("ticket"."order_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket"."courtesy_id" IS NOT NULL))
    )
